# Invalidate address-book lookup state before notifying card changes

At the accepted endpoint, add, modify and delete internals call MailServices.ab.clearCache before their card notifications. clearCache increments mail.displayname.version; its observer discards addressCache and signals addrbook-displayname-changed. This applies even to a blank displayName card. It supersedes a narrow assumption that only visible-name changes require invalidation. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: mailnews/addrbook/modules.
